title: Penkovsky papers: a Nazi psychic unit taken over by the Soviets
place_text: Germany; Soviet Union; Monterey, California (language school)

tellings.quote: And it said that um Adolf Hitler had had a unit called Dr. Grunbomb in Germany

plain: Adolf Hitler had a psychic unit in Germany, which the Soviets later took over, according to reading material in Russian credited to a Soviet colonel named Igor Pinkovski. Lyn Buchanan, a former US Army sergeant who worked as a psychic spy, says he read this himself while learning Russian at a language school in Monterey, California, and that it said Hitler "had a unit called Dr. Grunbomb". If true, it would mean psychic spying passed from the Nazis to the Soviets.
